name: Mahou Shoujo no Ani ~Heta na Uso to Furyou Shounen~
original_name: 魔法少女の兄 ～下手な嘘と不良少年～
source:
It took three hours from Tokyo, and involved changing trains on several different lines.
The only thriving area was in front of the station, and the rest was just dirt roads as far as the eye could see - a typical rural area.
That was our new home.
I was a transfer student who had moved from Tokyo to this rural area due to my father's work.

Fortunately, I was blessed with great classmates at my new school and enjoyed my days.
Then, one day, a few days after we moved.

I returned home from school and opened the front door to find my sister lying there, covered in wounds.
I quickly picked up the phone, trying to call an ambulance...but someone stopped me.
I turned around to see my sister, who was supposed to have collapsed.
I started to ask why, but my sister's voice drowned me out, saying, "It's nothing."
As I treated her wounds, I pressed her on what had happened.

Most of the injuries were scrapes and marks from beatings, clear evidence that she had been harmed by someone.
I was thinking that I might have to report this to the police when my sister said,, "Well, you see... the truth is... I'm a magical girl!"

Her eyes were unfocused, and they were clearly filled with anxiety and fear.

What exactly was my sister trying to hide, making such a lame excuse?
At that time, I still didn't understand anything.

translation:
从东京出发要花三个小时，还得换乘好几条线路。
车站前是唯一繁华的地方，除此之外放眼望去尽是土路，是一片典型的乡下。
那就是我们的新家。
我因父亲工作调动，从东京转学来到这片乡下。

幸运的是，新学校里的同学都很友善，我度过了愉快的日子。
然而，搬家几天后的某一天……

我放学回家，打开门，发现妹妹浑身是伤地躺在那里。
我连忙拿起电话想叫救护车……却有人阻止了我。
我转过身，看见本该倒下的妹妹站了起来。
我刚想问她为什么，她却抢先说道：“没什么。”
我一边替她处理伤口，一边追问究竟发生了什么。

大部分伤口都是擦伤和殴打留下的痕迹，显然有人伤害了她。
我正想着是否要报警，妹妹却说：“那个……其实……我是魔法少女！”

她的双眼没有焦点，里面明显充满了不安与恐惧。

妹妹究竟想隐瞒什么，才会编出这么蹩脚的借口？
那时的我，仍然什么都不明白。
